links.comparator_used: Pre-Spanish-version period (English-only chatbot) among Spanish-speaking patients identified in the medical record, before vs after a professionally translated Spanish version launched
links.outcome: Chatbot reach (share of recipients opening the chatbot) among Spanish-preferring patients
links.effect: Newborn chatbot: reach rose from 58% (301/519) to 66.2% (157/237), OR 1.42 (95% CI 1.03-1.96). Postpartum chatbot: reach rose from 61.8% (277/448) to 63.9% (136/213), OR 1.09 (95% CI 0.78-1.53), not significant.
links.quote: We found significant improvements in reach for Spanish-speaking patients after deploying the Spanish version of the newborn chatbot (OR 1.42, 95% CI 1.03-1.96), but no significant differences in reach were found for the postpartum chatbot (OR 1.09, 95% CI 0.78-1.53).

design_hint: Spanish-language version and discharge paperwork promotion to improve chatbot reach
